items.summary: Retain containment and do not admit new CRO implementation this cycle. The only evidence-backed revenue experiment is the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after capacity release and five-item site-overlap clearance. Baseline: 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, 0 shipped items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21; the $4.92 aggregate commission remains unattributed. Metric: affiliate clicks plus attributable ordered/shipped items over 14 days or 100 relevant impressions/clicks. Time-to-learn: the first threshold reached. Smallest reversible prototype: CTA hierarchy, adjacent disclosure placement, keyboard/focus states, and responsive spacing on existing commercial surfaces, preserving destinations, tracking, and content meaning. Do not claim revenue, ROI, or causal lift.

Preserve and execute only existing request 4719e525-763b-42a4-9f16-e71e1c38b17b after the canonical saveusfarms.com repair case releases a slot and allthingsmasonic.com overlap is cleared. Acceptance: deterministic tests, build, link and disclosure checks, keyboard/focus audit, responsive validation, unchanged affiliate destinations/tracking, exact diff, rollback point, and measurement setup. Roll back only this bounded change if validation fails or the relevant metric regresses.

Do not retain new GitHub-driven product proposals. markitdown and mermaid have plausible SEO/content use cases and MIT licenses, while shadcn-ui/ui has a plausible UX use case and MIT license; however, repo-lab evidence is discovery-only, dependency installation was not performed, security and maintenance risk remain unvalidated, and current delivery capacity is 10/10 occupied. Revisit only through a disposable prototype after measurement debt and capacity gates clear. Smallest prototype would convert one approved internal content artifact or render one isolated component without production access, dependencies added to the fleet, or deployment.

Keep complicated.work as the first planning-only product opportunity. Do not build or publish yet: analytics are not configured and launch-readiness, legal/compliance, security, attribution, and rollback evidence are incomplete. After capacity clears, produce exactly one readiness artifact. Smallest reversible prototype is a preview-only branded homepage with one content seed and no public exposure, tracking expansion, affiliate activation, domain changes, or spend. Metric: launch-checklist completeness and preview-quality acceptance; time-to-learn: one readiness cycle.
